description: This is a Java unit test file for the class ImmutableJsonLong, which tests the behavior and properties of ImmutableJsonLong objects, including equality, hash code, type checks, and conversions.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonLongTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ImmutableJsonLong, containing nested parameterized test class.

classes.name: ParameterizedTests
classes.description: Nested parameterized test class within ImmutableJsonLongTest that tests ImmutableJsonLong with various long values.

methods.name: doubleValues
methods.description: Provides test data: a collection of Long values including Long.MIN_VALUE, Long.MAX_VALUE, 0L, and a sample long.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ImmutableJsonLong instance for each parameterized test case.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that ImmutableJsonLong instances are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies correct implementation of hashCode and equals for ImmutableJsonLong.

methods.name: jsonLongEqualsJsonIntIfSameValue

methods.name: jsonLongHasSameHashCodeAsJsonIntIfSameValue
methods.description: Verifies hash code consistency between ImmutableJsonLong and ImmutableJsonInt for equal values.

methods.name: jsonLongEqualsJsonDoubleIfSameValue

methods.name: jsonLongHasSameHashCodeAsJsonDoubleIfSameValue
methods.description: Verifies hash code consistency between ImmutableJsonLong and ImmutableJsonDouble for equal values.

methods.name: toStringReturnsExpected
